steps.name: @Feature + @Variant annotations and proxy generation
steps.criteria: A feature interface annotated with @Feature and variant classes annotated with @Variant compile successfully, and a dispatch proxy is generated that implements the feature interface.
steps.scenario_name: Developer defines a feature with variants and a dispatch proxy is generated

steps.name: FlagProvider SPI and runtime dispatch
steps.criteria: A FlagProvider supplies flag values via getString(String key), the FeatureDispatcher resolves a feature to its active variant proxy, and method calls on the proxy are delegated to the correct variant.
steps.scenario_name: Developer resolves a feature to the active variant at runtime

steps.name: @PinFlag testing support
steps.criteria: A test method annotated with @PinFlag resolves a feature to the pinned variant without any flag provider setup.
steps.scenario_name: Developer pins a flag value in a test with a single annotation

steps.name: Free-form variant values without enum
steps.criteria: A feature interface without an inner Variant enum accepts any string as a valid variant value and compilation succeeds.
steps.scenario_name: Feature defined without variant enum accepts free-form values

steps.name: @Feature rejected on class
steps.criteria: Applying @Feature to a class instead of an interface produces a compile error stating @Feature can only be applied to interfaces.
steps.scenario_name: Feature annotation rejected on a class

steps.name: Fallback strategy configuration recorded at compile time
steps.criteria: A feature with an explicit fallback strategy compiles successfully and the strategy is recorded in the generated proxy metadata.
steps.scenario_name: Feature with fallback strategy records configuration

steps.name: Variant not implementing feature interface rejected
steps.criteria: A variant class that does not implement its declared feature interface produces a compile error stating the variant must implement the feature interface.
steps.scenario_name: Variant class that does not implement the feature interface is rejected

steps.name: Multi-feature variant registration
steps.criteria: A variant class annotated for two different features and implementing both interfaces compiles successfully and is registered for both features.
steps.scenario_name: Multi-feature variant registered for both features

steps.name: Default variant as fallback
steps.criteria: A variant annotated as default compiles successfully and is registered as the fallback for its feature.
steps.scenario_name: Default variant registered as fallback

steps.name: Variant value not in enum rejected
steps.criteria: A variant value that is not in the feature's inner Variant enum produces a compile error listing the valid values.
steps.scenario_name: Variant value not in enum is rejected at compile time

steps.name: Duplicate variant value rejected
steps.criteria: Two variant classes with the same value for the same feature produce a compile error identifying both conflicting classes.
steps.scenario_name: Duplicate variant value for the same feature is rejected

steps.name: REQUIRED strategy with incomplete coverage rejected
steps.criteria: A feature with REQUIRED fallback strategy and an inner Variant enum that has values without implementations produces a compile error listing the missing values.
steps.scenario_name: REQUIRED strategy with incomplete variant coverage is rejected

steps.name: REQUIRED strategy satisfied by default variant
steps.criteria: A feature with REQUIRED fallback strategy and incomplete enum coverage compiles successfully when a default variant is registered.
steps.scenario_name: REQUIRED strategy satisfied by a default variant

steps.name: Generated proxy descriptive identity
steps.criteria: The generated proxy's toString() returns a descriptive string showing its flag key (e.g., FlagZenProxy[checkout-flow]).
steps.scenario_name: Generated proxy provides a descriptive identity

steps.name: Generated proxy contains no runtime reflection
steps.criteria: The generated proxy source code contains no reflection imports and uses direct method calls or map lookups for dispatch.
steps.scenario_name: Generated proxy contains no runtime reflection

steps.name: Exactly one proxy per feature interface
steps.criteria: Every valid feature interface with at least one variant produces exactly one proxy class that implements the feature interface.
steps.scenario_name: Every feature interface produces exactly one proxy

steps.name: Proxy follows runtime flag value changes
steps.criteria: When the flag provider's value changes after initial resolution, subsequent method calls on the same proxy are delegated to the newly active variant.
steps.scenario_name: Proxy follows runtime flag value changes

steps.name: Same proxy instance for repeated resolutions
steps.criteria: Resolving the same feature through the dispatcher multiple times returns the same proxy instance.
steps.scenario_name: Dispatcher returns the same proxy instance for repeated resolutions

steps.name: Clear error when no flag provider configured
steps.criteria: Resolving a feature without a configured flag provider raises a configuration error with a message suggesting how to add one.
steps.scenario_name: Resolution fails clearly when no flag provider is configured

steps.name: In-memory flag provider for development
steps.criteria: An in-memory flag provider serves configured flag values, and the dispatcher resolves features to the correct variants using it.
steps.scenario_name: In-memory flag provider serves flag values for development

steps.name: Programmatic flag provider registration
steps.criteria: A custom flag provider registered via the configuration API is used by the dispatcher to resolve features.
steps.scenario_name: Flag provider registered programmatically via configuration API

steps.name: No value for unknown flag key with EXCEPTION strategy
steps.criteria: When the flag provider returns no value for a flag key and the feature uses EXCEPTION strategy, an unmatched variant error is raised indicating no flag value was found.
steps.scenario_name: Flag provider returns no value for an unknown flag key

steps.name: EXCEPTION fallback strategy
steps.criteria: When a flag value has no matching variant and the feature uses EXCEPTION strategy, an error is raised listing the known variants.
steps.scenario_name: EXCEPTION strategy throws on unmatched variant value

steps.name: NOOP fallback strategy
steps.criteria: When a flag value has no matching variant and the feature uses NOOP strategy, void methods do nothing and typed methods return safe defaults (false, 0, null).
steps.scenario_name: NOOP strategy returns safe defaults for unmatched variant

steps.name: Default variant takes priority over fallback strategy
steps.criteria: When a flag value has no matching variant but a default variant exists, the default handles the call regardless of the fallback strategy.
steps.scenario_name: Default variant handles unmatched values before fallback strategy

steps.name: NOOP fallback never throws (property test)
steps.criteria: For any feature with NOOP strategy and any unmatched flag value, no method call on the proxy throws an exception and return values are safe defaults.
steps.scenario_name: NOOP fallback never throws regardless of flag value

steps.name: Programmatic pinning via test context
steps.criteria: A test that receives a test flag context can pin a flag value programmatically, and the resolved proxy delegates to the pinned variant, scoped to the current test only.
steps.scenario_name: Programmatic pinning via test context

steps.name: Multiple flags pinned in a single test
steps.criteria: A test pinning multiple flags resolves each feature to its respectively pinned variant.
steps.scenario_name: Multiple flags pinned in a single test

steps.name: Pin value isolation between tests
steps.criteria: Pinned flag values in one test do not affect another test; each test sees only its own pinned values.
steps.scenario_name: Pin values are isolated between tests

steps.name: Feature interface injected as resolved proxy in test parameter
steps.criteria: A test method declaring a feature interface as a parameter receives a resolved proxy matching the pinned variant.
steps.scenario_name: Feature interface injected as resolved proxy in test parameter

steps.name: Flags loaded from properties file via @FlagSource
steps.criteria: A test class annotated with @FlagSource loads flag values from a properties file and the dispatcher resolves features accordingly.
steps.scenario_name: Flags loaded from properties file for test class

steps.name: @PinFlag overrides @FlagSource
steps.criteria: When both @FlagSource and @PinFlag are present, the pinned value takes priority for that flag while other flags resolve from the file source.
steps.scenario_name: Pin annotation overrides file-based flag source

steps.name: Missing flag source file error
steps.criteria: A test class with @FlagSource pointing to a nonexistent file produces a clear error stating the file was not found and listing the searched locations.
steps.scenario_name: Missing flag source file produces a clear error

steps.name: Pin always takes priority over file source (property test)
steps.criteria: For any test with both a file-based flag source and a pin annotation for the same flag, the pinned value is always used regardless of configuration order.
steps.scenario_name: Pin always takes priority over file source regardless of configuration order
